periods.time: Evening of the joint training camp's final day
periods.summary: While Hagun's main representatives return by bus, seven Akatsuki members attack Hagun, defeat remaining students and teachers, and set parts of the campus burning. The returning group finds Oreki, Ayase and others unconscious. Reisen Hiraga appears on the roof and announces Akatsuki as an unauthorized eighth school seeking to prove the Seven Stars festival meaningless without them.
periods.cause: Akatsuki's sponsors want a dramatic pre-festival demonstration that can force the League to acknowledge Akatsuki as a competing school.
periods.outcome: Hagun is heavily damaged; Akatsuki challenges Hagun's representatives directly and the 'pre-festival' battle begins.
periods.significance: Public debut of Akatsuki and the start of the political crisis that changes Seven Stars.
